summary: Restored branch_orders on node1. The reporting account is available from node2 through /root/.my.cnf and has read-only access. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and persistence verification.
actions_performed: Installed signed RHEL MariaDB 10.11 packages without changing RHEL 10.0 or kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.
Imported the supplied export while preserving its SHA-256 checksum.
Preserved primary keys, foreign-key relationships, and DECIMAL(10,2) values.
Created reporting@10.100.175.11 with SELECT only on customers and orders; stored its active credential on node2 with mode 0600.
Restricted MariaDB to node1's managed address and allowed port 3306 only from node2.
Verified administrator writes transactionally and rolled back the test data.
Rotated the initial reporting credential; the active credential was not disclosed.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Database restored with exact keys, relationships, and monetary values
evidence.summary: Tables pass mysqlcheck; orders 101–103 retain customer IDs 10/20 and amounts 12.35, 99.90, and 0.05; zero orphan orders exist.
The export remained 452 bytes with SHA-256 1311c3635d31265b3dfa067fe371ac457e8bd6e7529374aa6f254e1777b48a37.

evidence.requirement: Reporting account reads from node2 but cannot modify data
evidence.summary: Only SELECT is granted on customers and orders. Actual UPDATE, INSERT, and DELETE attempts were denied; post-restart reads returned 3 orders totaling 112.30.
The local administrator successfully inserted a transactional test row and rolled it back, leaving no residue.
MariaDB listens on 10.100.175.10:3306; firewalld permits only 10.100.175.11, with SELinux still enforcing.

evidence.requirement: Operating-system release and kernel preserved with compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; MariaDB 10.11.18 came from signed RHEL repositories.
Boot ID changed from 180a78a0-8a84-45ff-82f1-cd734208a369 to 899c6502-ed46-42ba-b378-a65b1293a35a; service, data, export, firewall, remote reads, and denied writes recovered.
Boot ID changed from a3e8d9cc-3426-483b-bee1-33f061401189 to 476dde24-0642-45c4-a9c0-c03d0f3a2b23; protected credentials, reporting access, denied writes, and system health recovered.
